suggested_requirements.text: The C2C infrastructure shall implement a repository for traffic data.
The C2C infrastructure shall provide a mechanism to exchange device control information between Traffic Management Centers.
The C2C project shall be implemented using the ITS Traffic Management Data Dictionary (TMDD) standard.
The C2C infrastructure shall interconnect several dissimilar traffic management systems.
The C2C infrastructure shall convert data deposited into it to a standard format based on ITS standards.
The Center shall provide network identifier, name, link count, node count, link data, and node data for each roadway network it maintains.
The Center shall provide link identifier, name, road number, type, nodes, direction, length, capacity, speed limits, and lane counts for each link.
The Center shall provide node identifier, name, jurisdiction, owner, coordinates, type, and link counts for each node.
The Center shall provide network identifier, link identifier, data type, delay, travel time, volume, speed, density, and occupancy for each link.
The Center shall support incident information including ID, description, location, status, affected lanes, classification, severity, and weather conditions.
The Center shall support lane closure information including ID, description, start/end locations, status, affected lanes, and schedule.
The Center shall provide status information for each Dynamic Message Sign including ID, name, location, geometry, status, message, and beacons.
The Center shall support device control commands for Dynamic Message Signs including network ID, sign ID, credentials, beacons, and messages.
The Center shall support status information for each Lane Control Signal including ID, name, location, geometry, capabilities, status, and pattern.
The Center shall support device control commands for Lane Control Signals including network ID, signal ID, credentials, and signal pattern.
The Center shall provide status information for each CCTV including ID, name, location, status, lock status, and current PTZ/Focus/Iris positions.
The Center shall support CCTV control requests including network ID, camera ID, credentials, and specific camera movement or locking actions.
The Center shall support status information for video snapshots including camera ID, status, direction, size, and JPEG format image.
The Center shall support CCTV switching commands including network ID, credentials, and video channel input/output identifiers.
The Center shall support status information for each ramp meter including ID, name, location, status, plan, and cycle time.
The Center shall support device control commands for ramp meters including network ID, meter ID, credentials, plan, and duration.
The Center shall support status information for each Highway Advisory Radio including ID, name, location, status, and current message.
The Center shall support device control commands for Highway Advisory Radios including network ID, radio ID, credentials, message, and duration.
The Center shall support status information for each Traffic Signal including ID, name, location, status, state, plan, and preemption status.
The Center shall support device control commands for Traffic Signals including network ID, signal ID, credentials, plan identifier, and duration.
The Center shall support status information for each Environmental Sensor Station including ID, name, type, location, status, reading, and alarm status.
The Center shall support status information for each High Occupancy Vehicle lane including ID, name, link ID, status, plan, and occupants.
The Center shall support device control commands for HOV Lanes including network ID, lane ID, credentials, plan, and duration.
The Center shall support status information for each Parking Lot including ID, name, location, status, capacity, utilization, and restrictions.
The Center shall support status information for each School Zone including ID, name, link ID, location, status, and state plan.
The Center shall support device control commands for School Zones including network ID, zone ID, credentials, and plan.
The Center shall support status information for each Railroad Crossing including ID, name, link ID, location, status, and estimated train arrival/clearance times.
The Center shall support status information for each Reversible Lane including ID, name, link ID, indicator status, plan, and direction transition time.
The Center shall support device control commands for Reversible Lanes including network ID, lane ID, credentials, plan, and duration.
The Center shall support status information for each Dynamic Lane including ID, name, link ID, indicator status, plan, and transition time.
The Center shall support device control commands for Dynamic Lanes including network ID, lane ID, credentials, plan, and duration.
The Center shall support status information for transit assets including bus stops, bus locations, rail stops, rail locations, and park and ride lots.
The Center shall support status information for Vehicle Priority including vehicle ID, intersection ID, priority request status, and service strategy.
The Center shall support summary information about network device status including counts and status data for all managed device types.
The device status requestor and Center shall support command timeframe requests including network identifier and device type.
